prompt:
3D highly rendered animation, soft 3D CGI look. Exactly four characters: Barnaby, Hazel, Anne and Baba. Only one Barnaby is in the frame. Subtitle-free, no logo, no watermark.

REFERENCES: @Image 1 gives Barnaby's head, antlers and colours, @Image 7 his back and @Image 8 his full body in profile facing right; @Image 2 gives Hazel; @Image 3 gives Baba and @Image 4 gives Anne, both full body; @Image 5 is the brass bell on its pole; @Image 6 is the location. Every Barnaby reference gives identity only, never size or crop: Barnaby stays at about 45 to 55 percent of the frame height, full antlers inside the frame with clear headroom.

CHARACTERS: Barnaby: chubby moose upright on his two hind legs like a person, red knit sweater with ribbed cuffs; antlers dark chocolate-brown, slightly darker than his fur, about 1.8 times his head width, short round prongs; giant round matte anthracite nose about half as wide as his face, short thick caramel-brown muzzle ending right behind the nose, big round amber-copper eyes, thick brown brows. Hazel: tiny chibi chipmunk, round head about 45 percent of her body, one dark chocolate forehead stripe, flat mint scarf, bushy S-curved tail that stays a big bushy S-curve the whole time, plump cream cheeks, two very big glossy solid black eyes. Baba: large moose father upright like a person, dark chestnut fur with grey grizzle, thick dark brows, half-closed eyelids over amber eyes, grey beard, round gold-rimmed glasses, plain forest-green knit sweater with a round ribbed collar; symmetric dark chocolate velvet antlers about 2.1 times his head width, four short thick round-tipped prongs per side; blunt face-coloured muzzle, giant round matte anthracite nose. Anne: moose mother upright like a person, no antlers, smooth round head, big round ears, dark chocolate-brown fur with a cream belly, amber irises, thick mustard-yellow knit shawl without fringe tied at her chest; blunt face-coloured muzzle, giant round matte anthracite nose. FORBIDDEN: any tail, tuft or tail-like bump on Barnaby; a small or shiny nose on Barnaby; Baba's antlers on Barnaby; white eye-whites on Hazel; antlers or buds on Anne; a patterned sweater on Baba; human fingers on any character; a second Barnaby; a fifth character.

LIGHT: silver full moon gives a thin cool rim light from the upper back; four paper lanterns give one soft, even, constant golden light that warms the faces. Barnaby's fur stays warm caramel-brown and his sweater deep red, Baba's sweater forest green, Anne's shawl mustard-yellow; the night is deep blue, never black.

SUBJECT & ACTION:
Shot 1, seconds 0 to 1.5, over Barnaby's shoulder, his back mostly to the camera: Anne has opened her arms and the ends of her mustard shawl wrap around Barnaby in an embrace, her chin beside his neck, never touching his antlers, which tilt up and back touching nothing. Hazel sits on his shoulder on the right side of the picture, leaning back out of the hug with one small smooth capless hazelnut clasped to her chest. Baba stands small in the soft background at the right by the bell pole, his forehoof against the cord, watching. At about second 0.4 Anne says warmly, her lips moving to the words, 'Look how big you are!' and at about second 1.2 her eyes drop to the red maple leaf stuck on the sleeve of Barnaby's near arm with an amber syrup smear, already there from the very first moment, as she goes on, 'Is that maple?'
Shot 2, from second 1.5, a cut to a side view in profile: Barnaby at the left facing the picture-right, Anne at the right facing left; the two ease apart one step so both mouths show; Hazel sits on his shoulder nearest the camera, leaning back with her hazelnut, not touching Anne; Baba stands small in the background at the far right by the bell pole. Anne finishes 'maple?' at about second 2.0, her eyes on the leaf, and at about second 2.4 the tip of her forehoof touches the red leaf and sticks to the sticky syrup around it with a small tik, her forehoof with no fingers.
At about second 3.4 Barnaby says sheepishly, his eyes on Anne's face, his lips moving to the words, 'I followed Papa's pie. It was a tree.' At about second 5.9 Anne gently pats his cheek with her forehoof, smiling. At about second 6.4 Anne laughs and says, her lips moving to the words, 'Papa's pie has a tree in it.' At about second 7.9 Anne's eyes slide to the right toward Baba.
At about second 8.2 the camera turns smoothly to the right to a medium shot of Baba at the right end of the table by the bell pole, Anne and Barnaby staying softly visible at the left edge. Baba, his eyes on Barnaby, says after a moment, his lips moving to the words, 'Hm. Maple.' with one small proud nod. From about second 9.6 the camera holds on Baba, Anne and Barnaby smiling at each other as the warm moment continues. Barnaby's antlers stay on his head the whole time.

SCENE: four round white paper lanterns hang still on one twine rope above the table, from the top of the tall wooden bell pole on the right to the maples on the left; a long wooden table with a golden pie, a bowl of cranberries, two corn cobs and a loaf of bread, nobody sitting, no chairs, benches or stools; a brass bell on a bracket on the bell pole at the right end of the table with one short braided cord hanging straight down, already there from the very first moment; a moonlit meadow of red and burgundy maples and fallen red leaves, a deep blue sky, no snow.

CAMERA: Shot 1: a steady over-the-shoulder medium wide shot of the embrace, Barnaby's whole back and full antlers inside the frame. Shot 2: after the cut a steady side-on medium shot of the two in profile, Barnaby about 45 percent of the frame height, the camera does not push in; at about second 8.2 one smooth pan right to Baba. Barnaby's full antlers stay inside the frame with clear headroom above them the whole shot (and every other character's antlers too), at least 20 percent of the frame height above the tallest antlers.

SOUND: only natural on-set sounds: a dry night breeze, a soft fabric rustle for the shawl, one small tik at second 2.4, one soft pat at 5.9, each word heard once, Barnaby warm young male voice, Hazel tiny bright girl voice, Anne warm motherly voice, Baba warm low father voice, one line at a time.
